ideas.pitch: An AI-powered no-code trading bot builder allowing students and local crypto traders to deploy automated strategies on perpetual DEXs.
ideas.title: Pacifico-Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the Pacifica Hackathon Grand Prize winner by delivering an intuitive end-to-end financial automation tool that appeals strongly to judge panels looking for functional utility.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace featuring decentralized USDC escrow payments built specifically on Base.
ideas.title: BaseEscort
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning architecture of the Synthesis Hackathon by implementing real-world crypto-economic primitives alongside autonomous agent workflows.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered risk detection and investigation platform that uses graph intelligence and gradient boosting to analyze complex environmental compliance networks.
ideas.title: EcoGraph-AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard graph-based engineering with explainable machine learning, a winning formula proven at the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A personalized nutrition and wellness platform utilizing local LLMs to deliver real-time dietary insights and predictive health recommendations.
ideas.title: NutriPath-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the success of the Hour Hackathon first-prize winner by packaging complex health data into a polished, consumer-ready interface.

ideas.pitch: A rigorous statistical forecasting tool utilizing Poisson GAM and multinomial share models to predict and backtest emerging artificial intelligence safety incidents.
ideas.title: ForecastSafe
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on genuine data science rigor and calibrated prediction intervals, matching the winning methodology of the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.
